name: Rakle Works Raw Feeding Calculator
author: rakleworks

sections.description:
Rakle Works Raw Feeding Calculator helps dog owners estimate how much raw food to feed their dog each day.

Users can:
* Enter their dog’s weight (kg or lb)
* Choose a goal (maintain, weight loss, weight gain, puppy/very active)
* Select meals per day

The calculator instantly displays the estimated daily feed amount and a per-meal breakdown.

Site owners can configure feeding percentages and defaults in the admin settings page, and optionally adjust display text and basic styling. The calculator is responsive and designed to work reliably inside Elementor and modern WordPress themes.

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Add the shortcode [raklwora_raw_feeding_calculator] to any page or post (including Elementor Shortcode widget).
sections.faq:
Does it work with Elementor?

Yes. The front-end click handling is implemented in a way that works in Elementor widgets and templates.

Can I adjust the feeding percentages?

Yes. Go to WP Admin → RW Raw Feeding Calculator and edit the percentages and defaults.
